text:
Situation: Sodium bicarbonate injection remains on the FDA shortage list first posted 2017-03-01 and still current as of 2026-10-21. Multiple manufacturers are listed including Exela Pharma Sciences, LLC, Hospira, Inc., Amphastar Pharmaceuticals, Inc., Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC, and Long Grove Pharmaceuticals LLC. Corvale General’s 84 mg/mL 50 mL vials (NDC 51754500105) are labeled by Exela Pharma Sciences, LLC. Corvale East holds 112 vials (9.2 days) and 49 vials (3.4 days) for a combined 6.1 days on hand. Corvale Lakeside holds 32 vials (9.3 days). Corvale General holds 380 vials (25.2 days) and 524 vials (32.9 days) of 84 mg/mL 50 mL vials.

Why (FDA record): FDA’s shortage database shows sodium bicarbonate injection as a current shortage originally posted 2017-03-01 and still current as of 2026-10-21. The listed manufacturers include Exela Pharma Sciences, LLC, Hospira, Inc., Amphastar Pharmaceuticals, Inc., Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC, and Long Grove Pharmaceuticals LLC.

Our position: Corvale General has sufficient 84 mg/mL 50 mL vial inventory to support internal transfers while maintaining at least two weeks’ supply. An alternate manufacturer, A-S Medication Solutions (NDC 50090681300), is stocked at Corvale General and was approved for interchange by P&T on 2025-12-08. The Exela plant received a Warning Letter on 2025-07-02.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 211 vials of 84 mg/mL 50 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — raises Corvale East to 14 days on hand; Corvale General retains 22 days. Approval: pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Transfer 17 vials of 84 mg/mL 50 mL from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside — raises Corvale Lakeside to 14 days on hand; Corvale General retains two weeks. Approval: pharmacy director (transfer request).
3. Use A-S Medication Solutions 84 mg/mL 50 mL vials (NDC 50090681300) as interchange — already approved by P&T on 2025-12-08. Approval: pharmacist.
4. Evaluate purchase from Amneal Pharmaceuticals Private Limited — not on FDA shortage list; label does not identify a known plant. Approval: buyer.
5. Evaluate purchase from Anthea Pharma Private Limited — not on FDA shortage list; label does not identify a known plant. Approval: buyer.

Not recommended: No additional actions at this time.
